reviews.author: Pamela R
reviews.title: Everything was perfect
reviews.text: Everything was perfect. Thanks a lot we enjoyed 6 professional dives with hammerhead Divers in cabo san lucas

reviews.author: Camilo M
reviews.title: 🤿 Top Dive Experience – Small Groups and Excellent Service
reviews.text: Great dive center in Cabo San Lucas. The staff are very friendly and professional, and the atmosphere is relaxed with small groups, which makes the experience much more personal. The team speaks several languages, the equipment is in excellent condition, and their diving standards and safety procedures are very clear. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Ambre S
reviews.title: Une expérience qualitative !
reviews.text: Je recommande fortement cette agence de plongée, Cristina et Ophélie sont très réactives, à l’écoute, et offrent un service impeccable. Que ce soit les équipements (Ophélie m’a même prêté ses propres affaires), la sécurité sous l’eau, le contact par message, elles sont au top !! Ophélie a été ma guide sur 4 plongées et on a passé de très bons moments ! Merci encore pour cette expérience ☀️🤩

reviews.author: Alberto H
reviews.title: Expedición a Gordo baja y alrededores
reviews.text: Fuimos a bucear a varios lugares en Los Cabos, incluyendo Gordo Banks, y la experiencia fue simplemente increíble. Nuestra guía Ofelia fue extraordinaria. Nos ayudó con todo el equipo, resolvió cada una de nuestras dudas y demostró un conocimiento impresionante tanto de los sitios de buceo como de la vida marina. Bajo el agua fue aún más impresionante: nos mostró muchísimos animales difíciles de ver y estuvo siempre atenta a nosotros. Se nota su experiencia, profesionalismo y pasión por lo que hace. También queremos agradecer especialmente a Cristina, quien nos apoyó desde el inicio con la cotización en tiempo y forma, y ya en el sitio nos atendió de manera estupenda. Todo fue claro, organizado y muy profesional desde el primer contacto. En general, todo el equipo de la compañía es altamente profesional. El equipo de buceo está en perfectas condiciones, el barco impecable y los capitanes excelentes. Todo el personal sabe perfectamente lo que hace y transmite mucha seguridad y confianza. Recomendamos ampliamente esta compañía. Sin duda volveríamos a bucear con ellos. No se van a arrepentir.

reviews.author: Andrea V
reviews.title: Unforgettable experience
reviews.text: I had an absolutely wonderful experience with Hammerhead Divers! Beyond the incredible marine life we encountered: humpbacks, hammerheads, and even a marlin 🤯 the entire experience was great from start to finish. Ophelia and the crew were phenomenal. Her dive briefings were clear and thorough, she was an excellent guide in the water, and truly a pleasure to meet. Communication pre-trip was also outstanding and easy! I would absolutely recommend diving with them!

reviews.author: Jose Eduardo L
reviews.title: Experiencia de buceo
reviews.text: Extraordinaria Experiencia, Ofelia y David fueron extraordinarios, la embarcación en buenas condiciones; en generar todo estuvo muy excelente Fue un gran día de buceo

reviews.author: Discover01622451943
reviews.title: Marine Conserved Dive
reviews.text: I loved every second of the dive. Cristina, Xavier and Ophelia took such good care of us. Would recommend 100%. Already planning how we are going to do it again.

reviews.author: Jeff L
reviews.title: Best diving company
reviews.text: I recently did my AOW with Hammerhead Divers. I had a GREAT time. My instructor was Ophelia and she was amazing. She helped and taught me lots of things. She is a great instructor and diver in general. Their communication is amazing. They are always there to answer any questions you have. If wife would let me go back to Cabo more I would do all my training with Hammerhead Divers. HIGHLY RECOMMEND

reviews.author: Sonia S
reviews.title: Really nice experience that I never forget
reviews.text: I did two dives with Hammerhead divers and It was amazing! I could hear the humpback whales singing very loud and clear underwater. We saw some mantas and rays and there whitetip reef sharks too. Ophélie was my dive máster, she was very nice and really profesional. I was the only guest so it was perfect! I highly recommend this company, good service for a good price!!

reviews.author: Oscar C
reviews.title: Amazing experience!
reviews.text: Great experience! First time diving and our diving instructor Ophelia was super nice and very thorough at explaining the process. She made us feel safe and comfortable throughout the whole trip. We would definitely do it again and we thank Hammerhead for an amazing experience!
